rachel: incoming pallet AWB 9400110899220000000000 arrived damaged. manifest 6 units (A800/H100 class) — 4 OK, 2 with bent PCI brackets + torn power pigtails. forwarder billed brokerage + salvage handling and wants us to either accept partial credit or return.
mike: upload photos + SMS to vendor portal pls. need serials to start RMA/insurance claim.
jun: infra-oncall here 1 we have 2 hot spares in dedicated-pool-eu-west-1 for 24h. can hot-swap if vendor doesn't prepay return. Ops billing needs notice before we divert.
vendor_rep: apologies 1 we're initiating courier claim. options: (A) prepay AWB now + cover brokerage, (B) replace 2 in 4 business days, (C) 40% credit per damaged unit. We prefer A or B.
rachel: serials posted to S3 and vendor portal: RDX-EU-1001, RDX-EU-1002. photos s3://redwood/claims/5532100001/. Vendor: please post AWB and written credit confirmation.
mike: finance note 1 if vendor chooses A, require credit memo before we clear provisional hold. if not, we'll debit reserved pool and invoice vendor later.
vendor_rep: AWB requested; courier tentative pickup 24h. submitted credit memo request to your finance contact.
ops-bot: rma-bot created RMA-9452 and ticket INC-7812 (assignee: jun). return hold window: 72h.
jun: starting hot-swap now. will update INC-7812 and attach depot acceptance photo once done. if AWB proof appears, I'll roll back.
mike: noted - billing hold flagged. set provisional debit if credit not posted by EOD+3.
rachel: thanks 1 escalation to supply-leads if claim not confirmed within 72h. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
